decision.standard_mode: only source-compatible approved templates use reviewed compiled handlers

decision.custom_mode: custom definitions are a distinct ruleset and require explicit host or campaign opt-in plus participant disclosure
decision.handler_authority: only an independently reviewed deterministic handler allowlist can map exact source clauses to compiled handlers
